comment: The methodology combines top-down derivation with bottom-up consideration of known components. This is pragmatic but introduces a risk that familiar components shape the results, despite the claim that the architecture is goals-first.

public.text: The methodology combines top-down derivation with bottom-up consideration of known components. This is pragmatic but introduces a risk that familiar components shape the results, despite the claim that the architecture is goals-first.
public.suggestedRevision: Explain how the process controlled for component-led bias, including whether capabilities were derived before candidate components were considered and how alternatives were evaluated.
